ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In figure (a), the input R(s) enters the left addition-subtraction node directly along one path and is subtracted with the feedback C(s) as negative feedback, obtaining R-C and then passing through gain 7; meanwhile, another path of R(s) passes through the upper s block, and together with the output of gain 7 enters the second summing node with positive signs, then enters the controlled object 1/[s(0.07s+1)], and the output is C(s). In figure (b), the input R(s) first passes through the input compensator G_f(s), then is subtracted with the feedback C(s) at the addition-subtraction node, then passes through gain 7 and the same controlled object 1/[s(0.07s+1)], and the output is still C(s). Reasoning: Let P(s)=1/[s(0.07s+1)]. From figure (a), the input of the controlled object is 7(R-C)+sR=(s+7)R-7C, therefore C=P[(s+7)R-7C], and after arranging, C/R=P(s+7)/(1+7P). From figure (b), C=7P[G_f R-C], so C/R=7P G_f/(1+7P). Since the requirement is that the closed-loop transfer function before and after the transformation remains unchanged, set the two expressions equal: 7P G_f/(1+7P)=P(s+7)/(1+7P). After canceling the common factors, obtain 7G_f=s+7, therefore G_f(s)=(s+7)/7=1+s/7≈0.14s+1.

推理：按照保持进入被控对象的信号不变的思路，在(a)中，被控对象输入为7(R-C)+sR。在(b)中，被控对象输入为7(G_f R-C)。为使闭环传递函数保持不变，应令二者对任意R和C相等：7(G_f R-C)=7(R-C)+sR。展开得7G_f R-7C=7R-7C+sR。两边的-7C项相同，抵消后得到7G_f R=7R+sR。因此G_f=1+s/7，即G_f(s)=1+0.142857s，近似为0.14s+1。
